Polenta cakes

Time: time
Servings: 3
Source: Chefparade
Tags: tested, savory, snack, side-dish, medium-effort, vegetarian, gluten-free

Ingredients

  • 160g Polenta, coarse
  • 950g Water or broth
  • 50-100g Parmesan, grated
  • Butter
  • Black pepper, ground
  • Nutmeg, ground
  • Salt
  • Oil

Instructions

Ratio is 1:4 polenta volume to water. Fe. 1 cup polenta to 4 cups water. Other things are used to taste.
Bring water with 1 teaspoon of salt to boil. Slowly add polenta while stirring, bring back to boil and cook until it thickens and gets creamy.
Take off the heat and add the parmesan and a few spoons of butter. Season and salt to taste.
Pour out on an oiled tray, about 1.5-2cm thick layer. Let cool completely, for 30-60min. Cut into rectangles or use cookie cutters to get shapes.
Heat up a bit of oil in a pan, medium-high heat. Place the cakes into the pan and let them develop a golden crust. They’ll stick to the pan initially, but once the crust is ready, they’ll unstick. You should be able to see the crust from the side; gently prod them to see if they are unstuck. Flip and repeat for the other side. Serve.
